title: Tesla, Inc. - Form 8-K - Item 2.03 Creation of a Direct Financial Obligation - filed 2026-09-29
text: On September 29, 2026, Tesla, Inc. ("Tesla") entered into the following credit agreements: a $20.0 billion senior unsecured three-year delayed draw term loan facility (the "Term Loan Facility") pursuant to a Delayed Draw Term Loan Credit Agreement, dated as of September 29, 2026 (the "DDTL Credit Agreement"), by and among Tesla, as borrower, Citibank, N.A., and the lenders and other agents party thereto; and a $2.0 billion senior unsecured 364-day revolving credit facility (the "364-Day Revolving Facility") pursuant to a 364-Day Revolving Credit Agreement, dated as of September 29, 2026, by and among Tesla, as borrower, WF Bank, as administrative agent, and the lenders and other agents party thereto. Tesla may draw upon the Term Loan Facility from time to time, no more than ten times during the 18-month period following the closing date. Tesla may also draw upon the Five-Year Revolving Facility and may request up to two one-year extensions, subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions. No loans were outstanding under the facilities as of September 29, 2026.

title: Sempra - Form 8-K - Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition - filed 2026-08-06
text: On August 6, 2026, Sempra issued a press release announcing its financial results for the three months and six months ended June 30, 2026. This Form 8-K is filed jointly on behalf of Sempra and its subsidiary San Diego Gas & Electric Company. The information furnished in this Item 2.02 and in the accompanying exhibit shall not be deemed to be "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, nor shall it be deemed to be incorporated by reference in any filing of Sempra, whether made before or after the date hereof, regardless of any general incorporation language in such filing.
